'''Dal Quirz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Kadrillian/Legends|Kadrillian]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] whom [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] forced to cultivate [[Kunda stone|kunda]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kadril]].

==Biography==
Dal Quirz was infected by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] with the [[Pacifog]] by which Quirz Father's orders followed. Thus he conducted her tests on [[Kunda]], which proved that she had made a filter for Fathers chemical weapon.

When Quirz came into contact with [[Lon Prador]] and the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]], she remembered nothing more about [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the Empire. Quirz was assisted by [[Rodno]], her young assistant. His experimental invention of the [[Vibro-crystal]] provided protection against the Pacifog. When Quirz remembered Vader, she allied her support to Leia and Chewbacca, while Han and Luke drew Rodno to the [[Nociv]] area, where the Kunda was. She joined Leia when the communications of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] were disturbed by an [[Orbiting relay|Orbital Relayer]].
